scalars.scalar_value: Master's degree in Divinity, Theology, or Pastoral Studies with at least four (4) units of clinical pastoral education (or its equivalent). Must obtain certification by NACC or APC or certification within 18 months to move to a Chaplain II
Experience, preferably in a hospital setting, working as part of a team

items.item_text: Must have one of the following license/certification: Board Certified Chaplain APC or Certified Supervisor of Clinical Pastoral Educationor Board Certified Chaplain BCC or BCC - JEWISH CHAPLAIN or Catholic Chaplain or BCC - CANADIAN SPIRITUAL
Certified Supervisor of Clinical Pastoral Educationor

Master's degree in Divinity, Theology, or Pastoral Studies with at least four (4) units of clinical pastoral education (or its equivalent). Must obtain certification by NACC or APC or certification within 18 months to move to a Chaplain II
Experience, preferably in a hospital setting, working as part of a team
Demonstrates commitment to the regional health system's mission by maintaining an attitude of caring, openness to change, respect for life, compassionate service and quality.

Supports the spiritual services team by actively participating in regional and departmental meetings and educational sessions, contributing ideas, issues and opportunities for improvement. Participates in interdisciplinary and performance improvement committees as assigned. Shares new concepts with regional colleagues and collaborates effectively with patient care staff.

Visits and ministers to patients and their families, providing counsel and determining appropriate care plans. Assesses needs and manages time and resources effectively, keeping accurate records of services rendered. Assigns a high priority to the terminally ill and those in mental, spiritual and emotional distress.
Communicates effectively with supervisor, co-workers, physicians, clergy members and the public.
Participates in continuing care rounds and patient care conferences, providing on-call services.
Provides effective grief counseling and education, and offers outreach grief counseling when appropriate. Helps coordinate services of area clergy when necessary.
